children: LAS VEGAS, NV / ACCESS Newswire / September 24, 2026 /

, the parent company of MORE, a membership platform focused on nightlife, live entertainment, and premium hospitality experiences, today announced that construction and remodeling have been completed at its new two-floor sports- and culture-themed venue on Las Vegas Boulevard.
The venue is scheduled to host a soft launch next week for industry guests, friends, and family, with an opening to the general public planned for the following week.

Completion of construction and remodeling marks a milestone in the company's Las Vegas expansion as it moves from venue development into opening preparations. The two-floor location reflects a focus on bringing people together through sports, culture, and hospitality.

"Las Vegas is shifting away from traditional nightclubs and toward experiences built around experiences, pop culture, and value," said Peter Klamka, CEO. "This venue aligns with that shift, creating a place where people can come together, enjoy a shared experience, and want to return again and again."
The phased opening will give the team an opportunity to welcome invited guests and refine operations ahead of the planned public opening.
is a publicly traded holding company focused on the experience economy through its MORE brand. The company's shares are traded on OTC Markets under the symbol BLLB.

This press release contains forward-looking statements, including statements regarding the anticipated soft launch, planned public opening, and the company's expansion plans. These statements are based on management's current expectations and involve risks and uncertainties that could cause actual results, including opening timelines, to differ materially. Completion of construction and remodeling does not guarantee that opening activities will occur on the anticipated schedule or that the venue or the company will ever achieve profitability. title: BLLB Announces Completed Buildout of New Las Vegas Boulevard Venue
